MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     date_diff('year', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE), DATE '2026-10-15') -
     CASE
       WHEN date_part('month', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) > 10
         OR (date_part('month', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) = 10
             AND date_part('day', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) > 15)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     2026 - CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '[0-9]{4}', 0) AS INT64) -
     CASE
       WHEN (
         CASE
           WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'January' THEN 1
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'February' THEN 2
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'March' THEN 3
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'April' THEN 4
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'May' THEN 5
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'June' THEN 6
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'July' THEN 7
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'August' THEN 8
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'September' THEN 9
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'October' THEN 10
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'November' THEN 11
           WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'December' THEN 12
         END
       ) > 10
       OR (
         (
           CASE
             WHEN regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '/') THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'January' THEN 1
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'February' THEN 2
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'March' THEN 3
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'April' THEN 4
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'May' THEN 5
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'June' THEN 6
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'July' THEN 7
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'August' THEN 8
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'September' THEN 9
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'October' THEN 10
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'November' THEN 11
             WHEN p.birth_date STARTS WITH 'December' THEN 12
           END
         ) = 10
         AND CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '[0-9]{1,2}', 0) AS INT64) > 15
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2
